cricosDefinition.value: CRICOS lists every provider and course offered to people studying in Australia on student visas
cricosDefinition.quote: CRICOS is the official list of all Australian education providers that offer courses to people studying in Australia on student visas and the courses offered.

ahpraGraduate.value: Graduates of an approved program apply to Ahpra for registration by meeting the registration standards, confirming identity and paying the fee; they may apply up to 90 days before completing the course including placements
ahpraGraduate.quote: When you apply, you need to demonstrate that you meet the requirements for registration ( registration standards ), confirm your identity and pay the relevant fee. ... We recommend getting your application in early, up to 90 days before the time you expect to complete all your course requirements, which includes any placements.
